title: Processed Order Event
description: Accepted lifecycle event emitted to the processed topic with event-time duration fields and, for delivered orders, event-time total delivery duration.

previous_event_timestamp.description: Event timestamp of the immediately preceding accepted lifecycle event; null for the first ORDER_PLACED event.

current_event_timestamp.description: Event timestamp of the accepted lifecycle transition.

stage_duration_seconds.description: Event-time duration in seconds between previous_event_timestamp and current_event_timestamp; null for the first ORDER_PLACED event.

stage_duration_minutes.description: Event-time duration in minutes between previous_event_timestamp and current_event_timestamp; null for the first ORDER_PLACED event.

order_placed_timestamp.description: Event timestamp of ORDER_PLACED; present for ORDER_DELIVERED records.

order_delivered_timestamp.description: Event timestamp of ORDER_DELIVERED; present for ORDER_DELIVERED records.

total_delivery_duration_seconds.description: Event-time total delivery duration in seconds; present for ORDER_DELIVERED records only.

total_delivery_duration_minutes.description: Event-time total delivery duration in minutes; present for ORDER_DELIVERED records only.
